summary: Backend-only test of Gateway._on_message NUL/whitespace stripping and Polish JSON error messages (json_error_pl), via real MQTT publish to broker.hivemq.com on a temporary non-simulated 3-chamber device (client Kowalski). New suite 12/12 passed; iteration34 Fatek regression suite 9/9 passed. Test devices deleted (only kowalski-a, chlodnia-01 remain).

minor.issue: Two common truncation cases still return English text: message cut inside a string -> 'Unterminated string starting at'; and 'Expecting value' in the middle of the message (e.g. '{"a": tr') -> 'Expecting value'. Add Polish mappings (e.g. 'niezamknięty cudzysłów – wiadomość urwana?', 'brak lub nieprawidłowa wartość').

An empty or NUL-only payload (body '' after stripping) is reported as 'wiadomość urwana…'. A clearer message would be 'pusta wiadomość'. Also '{"a": }' is classified as 'urwana' because of the pos >= len-1 check. Cosmetic.

action_items: Optional: Polish mappings for 'Unterminated string' / mid-document 'Expecting value', plus a separate message for an empty payload
critical_code_review_comments: Operator precedence in json_error_pl line 348 ('A or B and C') works but is hard to read; add parentheses
server.py is ~2128 lines; split it into modules (gateway, json/state validation, routes)
seed_data_creation: Temporary device nul35xxxx (client 6ad7dcc3261e5ba3c23315b7) was created and deleted in the fixture teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with '-n 0' (pytest.ini adds xdist). Results checked: NUL padding (50 bytes and padding to ~1058 B), CRLF/space around the message and NUL inside are all accepted (ok true, online, values correct). Missing '}' gives an error with 'wiadomość urwana…', the position and 'Koniec wiadomości: …<last 40 chars>' (no NUL). Concatenated -> 'dodatkowe znaki'. Unquoted keys -> 'cudzysłowach'. Non-UTF8 \xff\xfe -> 'znaki spoza UTF-8'. Missing comma -> 'brak przecinka'. Fatek {d:...} plus NUL accepted. kowalski-a online.
